verdict.rationale: Twenty is a CRM platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. The only evidence is Twenty's own pricing page listing 'MCP server' as included on every plan, which is a first-party claim of the capability. No setup docs, tool list, auth model or hands-on corroboration shows how an external agent actually connects. Missing for 10: MCP server documentation (endpoint/transport, connection setup), exposed tools/resources, authentication and permission scoping for MCP clients, and independent or hands-on confirmation that agents can connect.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
